posted_text:
❤️‍🩹 Reproductive Rights
MI HB 4703 — Michigan Insurers Must Cover Group Prenatal Care

Health insurers operating in Michigan will now be required to cover group prenatal care services for patients enrolled in group health insurance policies. The bill defines 'group prenatal care services' as up to 12 prenatal visits in a group setting of at least three people, based on an evidence-based model. ...
